beats.anchor: « Pour l'Afrique, explique-t-il à son voisin. Africa ! Socks ! Lucky ! »
beats.extras: Fans of the whole world in the same row of seats: a family all dressed in plain green singing with their mouths wide open; two university students in enormous straw sombreros; an old man in a white suit wiping away tears with a handkerchief; children with painted cheeks. All flags are plain bands of colour, with no writing and no crests.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his sunny yellow T-shirt with a red vertical stripe on the left chest, green shorts, scuffed white sneakers, his red sock on his right foot and yellow sock on his left foot pulled high above the sneakers, a plain yellow cap, the gap in his teeth showing. BriBri in his faded forest-green football shirt with white collar and white number 8, his fine shaved part on the left. Maman in her teal and yellow wax-print dress, braids in a bun, big golden earrings.
beats.action: Standing in the steep stand, Kaydoudou lifts one leg to show his mismatched socks to a tall smiling neighbour while vigorously shaking the man's hand with both of his, grinning from ear to ear. The students in sombreros laugh. Behind him BriBri watches, amused, and Maman reaches out to pull Kaydoudou back into his seat.
beats.location: The very top rows of a gigantic open-air stadium at night in Philadelphia, the bowl of seats dropping away below them, the green pitch tiny far down.
beats.light: Night lit by hundreds of white floodlights, colourful confetti-like glints from the crowd, warm faces.
beats.camera: Medium shot along the row, Kaydoudou and his raised socks in the centre, the dizzying drop of the stadium behind them.
beats.alt: Dans les gradins, Kaydoudou montre ses chaussettes porte-bonheur à son voisin et lui serre la main de toutes ses forces, pour l'Afrique.

beats.anchor: Puis il met la main devant sa bouche, comme Radio à Bonamoussadi.
beats.extras: Diego Ramírez (11): a small wiry Salvadoran-American boy with light brown skin, short black hair spiked with gel and a big chatty grin, in a plain T-shirt, holding the lid of a big cooking pot. His parents on the sofa: a cheerful Salvadoran-American couple in their late thirties with light brown skin, the father with a thick black moustache and a checked shirt, the mother with a long black ponytail and a flowered blouse.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his sunny yellow T-shirt with a red vertical stripe and green shorts, red sock on his right foot, yellow sock on his left foot, a paper flag tucked in his collar. BriBri in a plain green T-shirt, fine shaved part on the left. Papa: tall, short well-trimmed beard, light blue shirt. Maman in her teal and yellow wax-print dress, braids in a bun, golden earrings.
beats.action: Kaydoudou stands on the living-room rug with one hand cupped in front of his mouth like a microphone, commentating the match at the top of his voice, cheeks full of pupusa crumbs. Everyone waves small hand-coloured paper flags of Morocco, red with a green star. BriBri leans toward the TV, fists clenched. Papa is half standing, Maman laughs, Diego lifts the lid of a steaming pot of pupusas.
beats.location: The small living room of the beige house in Waldorf on a summer night, the TV glowing on a low cabinet, its screen only a blur of green light.
beats.light: Warm lamp light mixed with the cool flicker of the TV, steam from the pot catching the glow.
beats.camera: Medium shot from beside the TV looking back at the family, Kaydoudou and his imaginary microphone in the centre, paper flags fluttering all around.
beats.alt: Le soir du quart de finale, Kaydoudou commente le match du Maroc comme Radio, la main devant la bouche, au milieu des drapeaux en papier.

beats.extras: Diego Ramírez (11): small wiry Salvadoran-American boy, light brown skin, short black gelled hair, dancing with Abuela Rosa, his tiny grandmother with light brown skin, white hair in a bun and a rosary of beads in her hand, laughing. Uncles, aunts and cousins of all ages jumping and hugging. A small brown dog with floppy ears, a green parrot flapping its wings in a cage.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his sunny yellow T-shirt with a red vertical stripe and green shorts, red sock on his right foot, yellow sock on his left foot. BriBri in a plain green T-shirt and jeans, fine shaved part on the left, his notebook covered in green and orange wax cloth open on his knees.
beats.action: The whole crowded house erupts in joy: Diego spins his grandmother around, cousins leap in the air, the parrot flaps wildly, and Kaydoudou dances holding the front paws of the little dog. In the middle of all this noise, BriBri sits motionless on the floor in front of the huge TV, his notebook on his knees, eyes shining, as if he has just understood everything.
beats.location: The small, packed living room of the Ramírez family on a July night: a television covering the whole wall, its screen just a blur of red and green light, framed family photos, a bird cage by the window.
beats.light: Bright, chaotic warm light from the lamps and the glowing TV, a calm pool of light around BriBri.
beats.camera: Wide shot from a corner of the room, the joyful chaos all around the edges, BriBri still and centred in front of the screen.
beats.alt: Chez les Ramírez, tout le monde danse et crie de joie, sauf BriBri, immobile devant la télé, son carnet sur les genoux.
